scope: Staging and output bounds for ordinary entity and table-entry common reactor references in the DXF writer.

behavior: Entity field validation rejects reactor vectors larger than dwgSafety::MaxReactorCount (1,000,000) before entity-record publication.
Table-entry preflight applies the same maximum before object-record publication.
Entity and table-entry common reactor staging uses DRW::reserve, which catches allocation exceptions and returns through the writer's existing refusal path.
Ordinary reference-ID and resolver-zero omission behavior remains covered by the existing common-reference output-ID selector.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary LINE and DICTIONARY each refuse 1,000,001 typed reactor references with an empty destination.

limitations: This bounds and safely reserves only entity and table-entry common reactor staging. It does not establish allocation-failure injection coverage or corpus-wide resource safety.
IMAGEDEF and other specialized reactor/reference assembly paths remain separate audit targets.
next: Continue the bounded allocation and rollback audit on distinct source-backed writer paths, beginning with specialized reference assembly not covered here.
